questions.question: How many natural number up to 2001 divisible by 3 or 4 but NOT by 5?
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Numbers which are divisible by 'a' or 'b' = (Number divisible by 'a') + (Number divisible by 'b') - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 'a' and 'b')

**Calculation:**

Number which is divisible by 3 or 4 up to 2001 are = 2001/3 + 2001/4 - 2001/12 = 667 + 500 - 166 = 1001

Now,

Numbers which are divisible by 3 or 4 but not by 5 = (Numbers divisible by 3 or 4) - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 3 and 5) - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 4 and 5) + (Number divisible by lcm of 3, 4, and 5)

Numbers which is divisible by 3 or 4 but not by 5 up to 2001 are = 1001 - 2001/15 - 2001/20 + 2001/60 = 1001 - 133 - 100 + 33 = 801

**∴ The correct answer is 801.**

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠C = 90°. M and N are the mid-points of sides AB and AC, respectively. CM and BN intersect each other at D and ∠BDC = 90°. If BC = 8 cm, then the length of BN is;
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d58bf01b729e9597b75bfcd1d8a9bc0542c88e1a0ccec150300e7644801a620.png] 

As we know,

CM and BN are median.

CM : DM = 3x : x and BN : DN = 3y : y

⇒ CM = AM = BM = 3x

⇒ AB = 6x

Let AC be 2z.

⇒ AN = CN = z

In ΔABC,

AB² = AC² + BC²

⇒ 36x² = 4z² + 64

⇒ 9x² = z² + 16 ----(1)

In ΔCDB,

BC² = CD² + BD²

64 = 4x² + 4y²

x² + y² = 16 ----(2)

In ΔCNB,

BN² = CN² + BC²

⇒ 9y² = z² + 64 ----(3)

From equations (1) and (3),

9y² = 9x² - 16 + 64

⇒ x² - y² = -48/9 ----(4)

From equations (2) and (4),

2y² = 16 + 48/9 = 192/9

y = 4√6/3

BN = 3y = 3 × (4√6/3) = 4√6

**∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**As BN and CM are medians of ΔABC, D is centroid of the triangle.

So, D will divide BN in the ratio 2 : 1

⇒ BD : DN = 2 : 1

Let BD = 2x and DN = x

⇒ BN = 3x

Also in right angled ΔCNB, CD perpendicular to BN

⇒ BC² = (BD) × (BN)

⇒ (8)² = (2x) × (3x)

⇒ 64 = 6x²

⇒ x = 4√6/3

⇒ BN = 3x = 3 × (4√6/3) = 4√6

∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm.

questions.question: Two equal sum (in Rs.) are lent at 8% and 4% simple interest p.a. respectively at the same time. The first sum is received 2 years earlier than the other and the amount received in each case is Rs. 14,500. Each sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P₁ = P₂, R₁ = 8% and R₂ = 4%

The first sum is collected 2 years earlier than the second

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let Principal be p and time be t

According to the question

p + (p × 8 × t)/100 = p + (p × 4 × (t + 2)/100

8pt = 4pt + 8p

8p = 4pt

t = 8p/4p = 2

t = 2 years, r = 8%

As we know,

p + prt/100 = Amount

p + (p × 8 × 2)/100 = 14500

116p/100 = 14500

p = 14500 × 100/116

p = 12500

**∴ The correct answer is 12500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let P be the sum in both cases

Also, let time for the first amount be T years

⇒ Time for the second amount is (T + 2) years

Both Amounts are equal

⇒ 8T% of P = 4(T + 2)% of P

⇒ 8T = 4T + 8

⇒ T = 2 years

Now, amount = 14500, R = 8%, and T = 2 years

⇒ 116% of P = 14500

⇒ P = 12500

∴ The correct answer is 12500

questions.question:
In the figure, in ΔPQR, PT ⊥ QR at T and PS is the bisector of ∠QPR. If ∠PQR = 78°, and ∠TPS = 24°, then the measure of ∠PRQ is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d5bd19c58502f66ffb9d09fbfffef372e0bef56957ae54bde484d0242cafd4.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** As we know,

∠TPS = (∠TQP - ∠PRQ)/2

24 = (78 - ∠PRQ)/2

78 - ∠PRQ = 24 × 2 = 48

∠PRQ = 78 - 48 = 30

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given: **

 In ΔPQR, PT ⊥ QR at T and PS is the bisector of ∠QPR

∠PQR = 78° and ∠TPS = 24° 

**Calculation:**

In ΔPQT,

∠QPT = 180° - ∠PQR - ∠PTQ = 180° - 78° - 90° = 12°

∠SPQ = ∠QPT + ∠TPS = 12° + 24° = 36°

Since PS is the bisector of ∠QPR.

∠QPR = 2 × ∠SPQ = 2 × 36° = 72°

In ΔPQR,

∠PRQ = 180° - ∠PQR - ∠QPR = 180° - 78° - 72° = 30°

**Hence the required answer is 30° **

If x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴ = 133 and x² - xy + y² =7, then what is the value of xy?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = 133

x2 - xy + y2 =7

**Concept used:**

(x2 - xy + y2) (x2 + xy + y2) = x4 + x2y2 + y4

**Calculation:**

x² - xy + y² = 7 ---(1)

As we know,

(x² - xy + y²) (x² + xy + y²) = x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴

7 × (x² + xy + y²) = 133

x² + xy + y² = 19 ---(2)

Subtract equation (1) from equation(2)

2xy = 12

xy = 12/2 = 6

**∴ The Required answer is 6.**

questions.question: On selling an article for Rs. 115, the gain is 20% more than the loss incurred on selling it for Rs. 104. If the article is sold for Rs. 130.80, then the profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
Let CP of the article be Rs. X.

According to the question

(115 – x) = (x – 104) × 120/100

5(115 – x) = 6(x – 104)

575 – 5x = 6x – 624

6x + 5x = 624 + 575

11x = 1199

x = 1199/11

x = 109

CP of the article = Rs. 109

New SP of the article = Rs. 130.80

Profit percentage = (130.80 – 109)/109 × 100 = 20%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Gain/Loss = (100 + 20)/100

⇒ 120/100 = 6/5

In both cases Cost price will be same.

⇒ S.P₁ - Gain = S.P₂ + Loss

⇒ 115 - 6x = 104 + 5x

⇒ 6x + 5x = 115 - 104

⇒ 11x = 11

⇒ x = 1

Putting x = 1 

⇒ 115 - 6 = 109 that is C.P.

New SP of the article = Rs. 130.80

Profit percentage = (130.80 – 109)/109 × 100 = 20%

questions.question: Pipe A and B can empty a full tank in 18 hours and 24 hours, respectively. Pipe C alone can fill the tank in 36 hours. If the tank is 5/6 full and all the three pipes are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be emptied?

Time required = Total work/Efficiency

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97af5ed5180d0c7a3016e9b734afcc3d2beefdbccfda881b3b4157d2ba5e1eed.png]

questions.question: The height of a cylinder is 2/3rd of its diameter. Its volume is equal to the volume of a sphere whose radius is 4 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm²) of the cylinder?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The height of a cylinder is 2/3rd of its diameter.

Cylinder volume is equal to the volume of a sphere whose radius is 4 cm.

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr2h

Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR3

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 πrh

**Calculation:**

Let radius of cylinder be 3x

Diameter of cylinder = 2 × 3x = 6x

Height of the cylinder = 6x × 2/3 = 4x

Radius of sphere R = 4 cm

As we know,

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR³

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 πrh

According to the question

πr²h = 4/3 πR³

3x × 3x × 4x = 4/3 × 4 × 4 × 4

x³ = (4 × 4 × 4)/(3 × 3 × 3)

x = ∛(4 × 4 × 4)/(3 × 3 × 3) = 4/3

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 πrh = 2π × 3x × 4x = 2π × 3 × 4/3 × 4 × 4/3 = 128 π/3

questions.question: If x² –4x + 1 = 0, then what is the value of (x⁶ + x⁻⁶)?
questions.solution:
x² – 4x + 1 = 0

Divided by x

x – 4 + 1/x = 0

x + 1/x = 4

As we know,

(x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2

4² = x² + 1/x² + 2

x² + 1/x² = 16 – 2 = 14

Again As we know,

(x² + 1/x²)³ = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + 3(x² + 1/x²)

(14)³ = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ + 3 × 14

x⁶ + x⁻⁶ = 2744 – 42 = 2702

questions.question: The average of 19 numbers is 22.8. The average of the first ten number is 18.4 and that of the last ten numbers is 28.6. If the 10th number is excluded from the given numbers, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 19 numbers = 22.8

Sum of the 19 numbers = 22.8 × 19 = 433.2

Average of next 10 numbers = 18.4

Sum of next 10 numbers = 18.4 × 10 = 184

Average of last 10 number = 28.6

Sum of last 10 number = 28.6 × 10 = 286

10th number = 286 + 184 – 433.2 = 36.8

Sum of 18 number = 433.2 – 36.8 = 396.4

Average of 18 number = 396.4/18 = 22 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average of 19 numbers = 22.8 

Average of next 10 numbers = 18.4

⇒ 18.4 - 22.8 = (-4.4)

Average of last 10 number = 28.6

⇒ 28.6 - 22.8 = 5.8

Net Increase = -4.4 × 10 + 5.8 × 10

⇒ 14

10th Number = 14 + 22.8 = 36.8

Sum of the 19 numbers = 22.8 × 19 = 433.2

When 10th number excluded then,

Sum of 18 number = 433.2 – 36.8 = 396.4

Average of 18 number = 396.4/18 = 22

questions.question: A train of length 342 m is running at 54 km/h. In how much time (in seconds) will it cross a bridge of length 438 m?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

A train length = 342 m

Train speed = 54 km/h

Bridge length = 438 m

**Formula used:-**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:-**

Speed of train = 54 km/h

Length of train = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s

Length of bridge = 438 m

∴ Total distance = Train length + Bridge length

Total length = 342 + 438 = 780

∴ Time = 780/15 = 52 sec

∴ **The required time to cross a bridge is 52 sec.**

questions.question: 3 men and 5 women together can complete a work in 6 days, whereas 4 men and 9 women together can do it in 4 days. How many women are required to do the same work in 7 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

3 men + 5 women = 6 days

4 men + 9 women = 4 days

**Calculation:-**

Let efficiency of 1 man and 1 woman be x and y respectively

As we know,

Total work = Total work

According to the question

(3x + 5y)6 = (4x + 9y)4

18x + 30y = 16x + 36y

18x – 16x = 36 – 30y

2x = 6y

x/y = 6/2 = 3/1

x : y = 3 : 1

Total work = (3 × 3 + 5 × 1) 6 = 84

Let n women complete the whole work in 7 days, then

n × 1 × 7 = 84

n = 84/7 = 12

∴ **Required number of women is 12.**

questions.question: The sides of a triangular field are 120 m, 170 m and 250 cost of levelling the field at the rate of Rs. 7.40/m² is:
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Sides of triangular field = 120 m × 170 m × 250 m

Rate = Rs. 7.40/m²

**Formula used:-**

Area of triangle = √S(S – a)(S – b)(S – c)

where, S = (a + b + c)/2

**Calculation:-**

Dimension of triangular field are 120m, 170m and 250m

S = (120 + 170 + 250)/2 = 540/2 = 270

As we know,

Area of triangle = √S(S – a)(S – b)(S – c)

= √{270(270 – 120)(270 – 170)(270 – 250)}

= √{270 × 150 × 100 × 20}

= √(9 × 3 × 10 × 5 × 3 × 10 × 4 × 5 × 100)

= 3 × 3 × 10 × 5 × 2 × 10

= 9000 m²

Cost of levelling 1 m² = Rs. 7.40

Cost of levelling 9000 m² = 7.40 × 9000 = Rs. 66600

∴ **Required cost of leveling is 66000.**

x = 2250

questions.question: The radius and height of a right circular cone are in the ratio 1 : (2.4). If its curved surface area is 2502.5 cm². Then what is its volume? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius and height of a right circular cone are in the ratio 1 : (2.4).

If its curved surface area is 2502.5 cm².

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area, S = πrl

Volume of cone, v = 1over3πr²h

**Calculation:**

Ratio of radius to height of a cone = 1 : 2.4

⇒ 10x : 24 x = 5x : 12x

r = 5x and h = 12x

⇒ l² = r² + h²

⇒ l² = (5x)² + (12x)² = 25x² + 144x² = 169x²

⇒ l = sqrt{169x²} = 13x

As we know,

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

⇒ πrl = 2502.5 cm²

⇒ 22over7 × 5x × 13x = 2502.5

⇒ X² = (2502.5 × 7)/(22 × 5 × 13) = 12.25

⇒ x = 3.5 = 7over2

Volume of cone = 1/3πr²h = 1over3 × 22over7 × (5x) × (5x) × 12x

⇒ 1over3 × 22over7 × 5 × 7over2 × 5 × 7over2 ×12 × 7over2 = 13475 cm³

questions.question: The internal length of a room is two times its breadth and three times its height. The total cost of painting its four walls at the rate of Rs 25/m² is Rs. 3,600. What is the cost of laying a carpet on its floor at the rate of Rs. 90.50/m²?

Rate 90.50 Rs./m²

The area of four walls, A = 2(l + b)h

Area of floor = l × b

**Calculation:**

Breadth of the room = 6x/2 = 3x

Height of the room = 6x/3 = 2x

Cost of painting Rs. 25/m²

Area of four wall = (1/25) × 3600 = 144m²

⇒ 2x × 18x = 144

Cost of laying carpet on 1m² = 90.50

Cost of laying carpet on = 72m² = 90.50 × 72 = RS. 651

questions.question: The ratio of expenditure and savings of a person is 5 : 3. If the income increases by 20% and the expenditure increases by 10%, then the person’s savings increase by:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of expenditure and savings of a person is 5 : 3.

the income increases by 20% and the expenditure increases by 10%.

**Calculation:**

The ratio of expenditure and savings of a person = 5 : 3

⇒ 50 : 30

Income of person = 50 + 30 = 80

New income of person = 80 × (120/100) = 96

New expenditure of person = 50 × (110/100) = 55

New savings = 96 - 55 = 41

Saving increased by = {(41 - 30)/30} × 100 = 36(2)/(3)\%
